concerns.text: Tasks T018, T019, and T020 are unchecked (incomplete). T018 (exclude learners w/o forum interactions) and T019 (exclude courses <50 learners) are mandatory for FR-002 and Assumption 2. T020 (generate ≥10k records) is the Success Criterion for US1. Leaving these unchecked violates FR-002 and SC-004.

Tasks T024 (median calculation), T025 (binning logic), and T026 (generate binned CSV) are unchecked. These are the core deliverables for FR-003, FR-004, and US2 Success Criteria. Without them, the statistical grouping required for FR-005 cannot occur.

Critical FR-005/006/007/008 tasks (T030-T039) are unchecked. T030 (Cohen's d), T031 (Tukey HSD), T033/T034 (stability/flip rate), and T039 (Proxy Validation) are mandatory. T039 specifically enforces Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy). Leaving these unchecked means the spec's core analysis and validation requirements are unmet.

Task T009 (schema validation) is unchecked. This violates Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) which mandates documented derivation and schema validation for all data transformations before processing.

Tasks T041 (README) and T042 (API docs) are unchecked. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires the project to run end-to-end on a fresh runner with documented usage instructions.
